scope: Bounded read-only comparison of the R15 API-seam preparation with R6, R8, R9, R13, R14 and the prior R15 advisory. No product, test, assembler, build, Git, model, UI, network or lease action was performed.

o_rdwr.finding: R15 adds exact nonzero os.O_RDWR capability preflight and requires O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC on the retained parent descriptor, with the same descriptor used for writes, seek/read verification, fstat and cleanup. It preserves O_RDONLY for resources/raw inputs and gives unavailable_primitive before output creation. This is consistent with R6/R8/R14 and the prior advisory.

output_setter.finding: R15 freezes the exact flat seven-key projection, exact str keys and exact positive int values within the R7 hard maxima, copied state, one successful call, install-before-set and second-call misuse errors, retained-data recheck, R9 limit details and C+2*N peak accounting. max_inline_normalized_bytes, fixed admission caps, config limits and Git limits remain outside this setter as required. No contradiction with R6/R9/R10/R14 was found.

git_caps.finding: R15 keeps the complete exact five-key materialized git map separate from the seven-key output projection, sends it to retain_bundle_bodies and the pure Git kernel, enforces lowered object-count/per-object/aggregate byte limits during body retention, and requires saved-state replay under the complete lowered map before success. This closes the projection/replay seam without changing the Git kernel.

private_error_facade_and_final_precedenc.closed: R15 specifies read-only code/message/details/exit_code, fresh plain-data details copies, the R8 nine-field I/O shape plus R9 extended reasons, separate limit/conflict shapes, idle phase, bounded prior metadata, resource/structure mapping, preserved kernel details, and the inherited R8 precedence: persistent lineage first, cleanup before original error when lineage is intact, otherwise original error. No precedence contradiction with R8/R9/R14 was found.

gap.problem: R15 requires fixed code-to-message constants and acceptance of safe messages, but explicitly defers the literal table to a future implementation instruction. The reviewed R6/R8/R9/R13/R14 material fixes the no-source-echo rule and error/detail shapes but does not supply the exact CodeProofIOError message for each accepted code.
gap.impact: An implementation cannot reproduce or assert the exact private facade messages for I/O, busy, resource/workspace, limit and conflict selections while preserving a byte-stable, source-free interface.
gap.required_closure: Before implementation dispatch, freeze the complete code-to-message literal mapping (including the resource/structure adapter boundary and the R9 limit/conflict codes) and make the acceptance vectors bind those literals. No change to the inherited final-precedence order is required.

boundary: The three projection/descriptor seams and final-error precedence are closed by R15 plus the inherited frozen contracts. Only the exact safe-message literal table remains an implementation-impacting closure; this review does not authorize implementation or dispatch.
